thread:
leo: heads-up — weird parity bug: Go SDK is sending model_selection as an integer (2) but REST expects the string enum 'best'. sample-app switched to sdk and started hitting a cheaper model unexpectedly. noticed in prod billing spike. :grimacing:

kyle: can you paste curl vs sdk payloads?

leo: curl (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-base-001","input":"Summarize this","model_selection":"best"}'
```
returns tokens from rwd-base-best.

Go SDK (broken):
```go
client.Generate(ctx, GenerateParams{Model:"rwd-base-001", Input:"Summarize this", ModelSelection: 2})
```
tcpdump shows body: {"model":"rwd-base-001","input":"Summarize this","model_selection":2} and server routed to rwd-base-fast instead.

ada: hmm, enums should serialize as their string names. generator must be emitting numeric enum values for Go. was there a change in the OpenAPI codegen template?

sam: adding logs: server accepted both numeric and string but numerical mapping is interpreted as index into policy list (0=cheap,1=balanced,2=best) — bug in routing layer made 2 map to cheap in one codepath. so two problems: SDK sending numeric, server buggy mapping for numeric. lucky we caught it.

kyle: I'll split fixes: 1) SDK generator should serialize enums as strings (safe, preserves readability). 2) server routing should reject numeric enum values or map them consistently. Filing INF-3810 to track both sides.

devx-bot: Created issue INF-3810: "Enum serialization mismatch: SDK emits numeric enums; server numeric mapping inconsistent -> unintended model routing" assigned to kyle, infra-team.

kyle: PR 877 opened for Go SDK: change enum type to string-backed and add unit tests that assert payload contains quoted enum values. also added a small e2e parity test comparing curl vs SDK for model_selection.

ada: I'll open INF-3811 for server hardening: treat numeric enum input as invalid with 400, and add a migration window to accept both with a warning header. we should avoid silent misroutes.

sam: workaround for affected customers: pin SDK to previous version or explicitly pass ModelSelection: "best" as raw map for now. sample-app patched to send the string.

kyle: cutting 0.8.6-patch with the enum serialization fix, plus tests. ETA ~30m. will update INF-3810 and the sample-app repo to pin patch.

devx-bot: INF-3810 status -> in_progress, linked PR 877, release candidate 0.8.6-rc1.

leo: confirmed sample-app with patched client now routes correctly in staging. thanks. can we add a generator lint rule so enum types are always string-backed unless explicitly annotated?

kyle: good idea — adding follow-up INF-3812 to add generator lint and a cross-SDK parity test suite for common enum fields (model_selection, format, priority).

devx-bot: INF-3812 created for generator lint and parity tests.

ada: also updating the SDK migration guide and adding a short note in the API reference: "Enum fields should be strings; numeric values are deprecated and will be rejected."

sam: thanks team 44aa — rollout looks fine after patch. closing the loop once infra ships the numeric rejection change.
